died.name: Torquato Tasso
died.last_words: Lord, into Thy hands I commend my spirit.

died.name: William Cowper
died.cause: to an attendant who offered him refreshments

died.name: Crowfoot
died.last_words: A little while and I will be gone from among you. Whither I cannot tell. From nowhere we came, into nowhere we go. What is life? It is a flash of a firefly in the night. It is the breath of a buffalo in the wintertime. It is the little shadow which runs across the grass and loses itself in the sunset.

died.name: Mr. & Mrs. Emile Froment-Meurice
died.cause: The famed French goldsmith and his wife were killed when their house, in an aristocratic quarter of Paris, collapsed on them.

died.name: George Sanders
died.last_words: Dear world, I am leaving because I am bored. I feel I have lived long enough. I am leaving you with your worries in this sweet cesspool - good luck.

died.name: Valerie Olusanya
died.cause: The 35-year-old electronic musician, better known as Kemistry, was a front-seat passenger in a car travelling on the M3 motorway in Hampshire, behind a van which dislodged a cat's eye in the road. The metal body flew through the windscreen hitting Olusanya in the face, killing her instantly.

born.name: Louis IX of France
born.last_words: I will enter thy house. I will worship in Thy sanctuary.

born.name: Edward II of England
born.cause: The English king was rumoured to have been murdered after being deposed and imprisoned by his wife Isabella and her lover Roger Mortimer, by having a horn pushed into his anus through which a red-hot iron was inserted, burning out his internal organs without marking his body. However, there is no real academic consensus on the manner of Edward II's death, and it has been plausibly argued that the story is propaganda.

born.name: Oliver Cromwell
born.desc: English general and statesman, Lord Protector
born.last_words: It is not my design to drink or to sleep, but my design is to make what haste I can to be gone.

born.name: Joanna Southcott
born.last_words: If I have been deceived, doubtless it was the work of a spirit; whether that spirit was good or bad, I do not know.

born.name: Princess Alice of the United Kingdom
Walter de la Mare
born.cause: when asked if he wanted some fruit or flowers
born.last_words: Too late for fruit, too soon for flowers.

born.name: Edward R. Murrow
born.desc: American broadcast journalist and war correspondent
born.cause: patting the hand of his wife, Janet Huntington Brewster
born.last_words: Well, Jan, we were lucky at that.
